title: Lingxin AI Raises Pre-A Led by SEE Fund for Hyper-Realistic Companion LMs
summary: On Feb 17, 2023, hyper-realistic LM vendor Lingxin AI (聆心智能) raised Pre-A led by SEE Fund, with oversubscribed follow-ons from Lianxing Capital, Turing Tech VC, Zhipu AI, Qichen Capital.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / funding · February 22, 2023

On Feb 17, 2023, hyper-realistic LM vendor Lingxin AI (聆心智能) raised Pre-A led by SEE Fund, with oversubscribed follow-ons from Lianxing Capital, Turing Tech VC, Zhipu AI, Qichen Capital.

Founded 2021 (spun from Tsinghua CS); Dec’22 product AI Utopia — describe a persona → deep-dialogue AI character, powered by controllable/configurable/anthropomorphic “Hyper-Realistic LM.” Team: Tsinghua / CMU / Google; 100B-scale training + commercialization experience. Industry view: Zhipu-class = China ~2–3yrs behind US; winners = Baidu/ByteDance-class or Zhipu-class institute spinouts — Lingxin as Tsinghua lineage is distinctive.

Deployments: Beyonca luxury EV cabin assistant; Emohaa emotion-healing bot with Haoxinqing psych platform — first China AI psych-companion digital human. Prior Dec round Lianxing-led + Turing/Zhipu. Roadmap: AGI Companion; AI Utopia Pro in beta — (1) one-click knowledge fusion into LM; (2) controllable (safety/ethics + enterprise era/persona constraints); (3) deeper anthropomorphism.

— END —
